description:
Reveals partner names, phones and e-mail unmasked: one lookup of the paid package, or one payment per company in the call itself.
It charges one unit of the paid Lookup package. The free allowance does not apply to reveals. Use the account (cookie with CSRF or `X-Api-Key: mmk_…`) or the wallet (`X-Credito: cred_…`) that owns the package. Without a package, the reveal pays for itself: the 402 has `ofertas[]`, `accepts` (x402) and `por_chamada` with the price per company; repeat with the x402 proof or with `Authorization: Bearer cred_…`, without an account. The same credit code does not pay twice for the same company, and nothing is charged if the record does not come unmasked. What the package holder revealed stays theirs: viewing the same company again does not charge again, on any day, even with another Idempotency-Key; `GET /api/revelar/:cnpj` returns it without a charge. A nonexistent CNPJ or a failing origin returns the unit. The answer is not cached.

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one (12 letters or digits and 2 check digits), such as 12ABC34501DE35.
